articles.title: Robin Williams’ Instagram account brought back to fight ‘AI abuse’

articles.title: OpenAI lays out new security changes after its AI hacked Hugging Face
articles.summary: OpenAI is announcing security updates following the July news that its AI broke out of a sandboxed environment and accidentally hacked Hugging Face, including improvements to its research environments, monitoring, and alignment techniques. articles.title: Apple squashes EU beef with new App Store rules
articles.summary: Apple is once again overhauling App Store rules in the European Union, which the company says will resolve its "disagreements with the Commission over business terms and alternative distribution."
